example_sentences_in_bangla: তার চেহারা দেখে মনে হয় করুণার অবতার নেমেছে।
এই ভবনটি তো করুণার অবতার, দেখতেই কষ্ট হয়।
example_sentences_in_english: His appearance makes one think the incarnation of pity has descended.
This building is the avatar of compassion – it's so ugly it evokes pity.
history: Plays on the concept of divine avatars (অবতার) in Hinduism, twisting the idea of a compassionate incarnation to sarcastically describe something pitifully ugly or deformed.
note: The idiom draws from religious terminology for ironic effect in Bengali speech.
